adjudication.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent and deleteEvent the fallback branch is incorrect: `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;` (and similarly for `calendarId` in delete) only executes the `find(...)` when `externalCalendarId` is falsy, but then it compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` where `externalCalendarId` is `null/undefined`, so it will never match a real calendar externalId. This makes the computed calendarId undefined and can cause updates/deletes to target the wrong calendar or fall back to default behavior (e.g., "primary" elsewhere) instead of using the event’s destination calendar.
